sourceNotes.rawContent: Exude serenity with this stunning aqua blue floral kada. The intricate gold botanical patterns are complemented by deep blue floral centers, all set on a premium anti-tarnish gold base. This high-quality bangle provides a refreshing pop of color while ensuring a long-lasting, radiant finish.
